test_title: PYST 29: SSC MTS 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘JACK’ is written as ‘LCEI’. How will ‘FURO’ be written in that language?
solution:
Here, we use the table given below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a27080208485b121c9837b1671bd9a0be60ad5888459a5db8efe65dce313f7e.png] 

**Logic:** Addition of (2) to the first three alphabet's positional values and subtraction of (2) from the last alphabet's positional value.

‘JACK’ is written as ‘LCEI’ →

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/039536dfc469b15a778b2c88b458d6ed6c25ef2f402971bf4d82cdd9072bf1c1.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1f123a3ff059c5ab846288dbcc437f1417a4840387e6254c7a14fcaa53a4511e.png] 

Similarly, ‘FURO’ will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/451a6c7f99bd6e60e253883a170f2048f6f5e42fdc4c55b28c7efcec5c4c2e41.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/099340740783baafbede9bfd81f4efc39e2073c7efbdf8a1532790092764a9d4.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "HWTM".
